dedupe_keys.name: gridded dataset for groundwater storage estimation in the duero using a deep learning model

description: The STARS4Water project and IGME-CSIC deposit monthly groundwater-storage-change inputs and outputs for Spain's Duero basin. The public README describes a 56 by 28 cell grid at roughly 11 km resolution in EPSG:4326, with 21 static predictor layers, dynamic climate and land-cover inputs, target and predicted storage-change rasters, and RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 scenarios through 2040. The 2013 to 2022 model period is separate from the future scenario range. GeoTIFF bands carry month labels; the storage-change unit is metres and nodata is minus 9999. Zenodo makes the ZIP and README public under CC0. A groundwater-supply simulation could use these spatial changes as comparison or stress-test inputs. The README reports held-out model R² of 0.556, so predictions should not be treated as observations. Upstream soil, land-cover and climate products have separate provenance. The archive was not opened, and its individual raster completeness remains unverified. No related catalogue record covers this basin release.
